query: SELECT h.id, h.symbol, h.name, h.quantity, h.purchasePrice, COUNT(p.id) as purchase_count FROM `etf_holdings` h LEFT JOIN `purchases` p ON h.id = p.holdingId GROUP BY h.id, h.symbol, h.name, h.quantity, h.purchasePrice LIMIT 10;
